scope: Follow-on objects; preserve already sealed candidates and reviews
direction: ImageGen is a design exploration, with native editor reconstruction, rather than a literal repaint of the original model.
allowed: Improve forms, proportions, silhouette and structural construction
Add purposeful decorations and crafted detail
Replace awkward modeling and change nonfunctional topology or part counts
Rebuild native geometry, normals, materials and light to realize the better design
locked: Registered camera/projection, logical frame, root, source scale and atlas layout
Game role, recognizable identity, occupied grid scale and palette family
Declared footprint, functional height/clearance envelope, contacts, attachments, ports and rig behavior
Every required facing, animation state, frame count, timing and loop behavior
Modular join planes, end profiles and family continuity
The three excluded restaurant floor designs
judging: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.
